title: Jiahao Creeper（嘉豪苦力怕）
description: Hello everyone! This resource pack is inspired by the viral Chinese internet meme "Jiahao".
body:
## English Translation
## 
Hello everyone! This resource pack is inspired by the viral Chinese internet meme "**Jiahao**".
In this meme, "Jiahao" is a classic funny character: he always wears an all-black outfit and a face mask, striking exaggerated poses while acting mysteriously and speaking nonsense in a deadpan way. The humor comes from his absurd attempt to look like a "mysterious big shot" when he's just an ordinary guy.
This resource pack transforms Minecraft's Creeper into a "Jiahao Creeper" — dressed in black, with green eyes that mimic a face mask, perfectly capturing the meme's funny, pseudo-mysterious vibe. Now your Creeper isn't just an exploding mob, but a "Jiahao" trying to look cool in your game!

f you like this, follow my Bilibili page to support me!My[Bilibili](https://space.bilibili.com/435304966/?spm_id_from=333.788.upinfo.head.click)

**This English description was translated with the help of AI.**

![114514](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/689836bdc79ce39fa01c4a48132e87ec0fce44f1.png)

## 中文介绍

大家好！这个资源包的灵感来自中国爆火的 “**嘉豪**” 网络梗。在这个梗里，“嘉豪” 是一个经典的搞笑角色：他永远穿着一身黑衣、戴着口罩，故作神秘地摆出各种夸张姿势，一本正经地说着无厘头的话，明明普通却非要装成 “神秘大佬”，这种反差感让全网都在玩这个梗。
这个资源包就把《我的世界》里的苦力怕，变成了 “嘉豪苦力怕”—— 一身黑衣，绿眼睛像口罩一样遮住脸，完美还原了梗里那个故作神秘的搞笑形象。现在你的苦力怕不再是单纯的爆炸怪，而是一个在游戏里装神秘的 “嘉豪” 啦！
